name: incanto-beacon-isle-3d
label: Incanto 3D Open-World Adventure Template
description: Incanto engine 3D open-world action-adventure template (Three.js underneath, the whole game is scene JSON). A generated island with terrain, sea, groves and grass; a quest NPC with dialogue; enemies that hunt the player across the terrain; melee combat with a bone-mounted sword; touch controls on phones. Pick this for a 3D exploration, adventure, action-RPG, survival or open-world game. The project uses the incanto-* skills — read incanto-your-first-game before the first edit. 3D only; not for 2D games.
tags: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild
